children: Amphenol announced a two-for-one stock split and a Q3 2026 dividend of $0.125 per share following the split.
Board approved a two-for-one stock split as a stock dividend; record date was August 17, 2026 and it has been effected.
Originally declared Q3 dividend was $0.25 per share; after the split the payable dividend is $0.125 per share.
Dividend will be paid October 14, 2026 to shareholders of record as of September 22, 2026.
